dialog.english:
��������I'm so tired. If I walk any more,
my legs will get thick.
dialog.translation:
Estoy muy cansado. Si sigo
caminando, me explotarán
las piernas!

dialog.english:
Mimi! This is why you should have
roots for legs!
dialog.translation:
Mimi! Por eso es mejor tener
raíces!

dialog.english: I don't want roots...
Looks like it's getting dark.

What should we do? It'll be
dangerous if we keep going after
dark.
dialog.translation:
Que deberíamos hacer? Sería
peligroso si nos quedamos aquí.

dialog.english:
I smell...I smell it! Fresh water!
There's a lake around here!
dialog.translation:
Huelo... Huelo agua fresca!
Hay un lago por aquí!

dialog.english: We're all tired and hungry...

Should we make camp at the lake
for the night?
dialog.translation:
Acampamos en el lago para pasar
la noche?

dialog.english: Whoa! It's a big lake!
It's the perfect place to camp!
dialog.translation: Es un lugar ideal para acampar!

dialog.english:
Hey, if we camp out here, does
that mean we'll have to sleep
outdoors?
dialog.translation:
Eh, si acampamos aquí... tenemos
que dormir a la intemperie?

dialog.english: Yeah, looks like it.
No way...
Hey! There's a trolley over there!
T-there is!

Why would there be a trolley car
in a place like this?
dialog.translation:
Por qué pondrían un tranvía
en un lugar así?

dialog.english: Huh? The lights went on!

Someone must be in this car! There
are people besides us here!
dialog.translation:
Alguien debe estar dentro! Hay
más personas que nosotros!

dialog.english: Let's check it out!
There's no one here.
Seems like it.

And after all those phones...
What's going on?

We should sleep here. Let's figure
this out tomorrow.
dialog.translation:
Deberíamos dormir aquí. Ya
pensaremos mañana.

dialog.english:
Tai! We still don't have enough
food!
dialog.translation:
Tai! Aún no tenemos suficiente
comida!

dialog.english: Yeah... Let's search a bit more!
We gathered a lot!

We all worked together and got all
this food!
dialog.translation:
Conseguimos toda esta comida
gracias a todos!

dialog.english: I'm really, really hungry.

All right! Time to head back for
dinner!
dialog.translation:
Muy bien, hora de volver
para la cena!

dialog.english:
Palmon says she can tell the
difference between edible and
poisonous mushrooms!
dialog.translation:
Palmon dice que sabe distinguir
las setas venenosas y comestibles!

dialog.english: Yep!
Digimon really are amazing!
Can you teach me how?

It's not just any Digimon who can
do this, it's Palmon!
dialog.translation:
No lo hace cualquier Digimon. Sólo
Palmon!

dialog.english: Oh, sorry.
Of course! It'll be fun!
Let's go mushroom hunting!

Gabumon, do you have any special
talents, too?
I'll bet he doesn't.
Hmmmmm.

What's wrong? Does your stomach
hurt?
dialog.translation: Qué pasa? Te duele el estómago?

dialog.english:
No! I'm trying to stargaze to find
our location, but I can't find the
North Star.
dialog.translation:
No! Intento ubicarnos con las
estrellas, pero no encuentro la
Estrella Polar!

dialog.english:
I can't see the Southern Cross
either. Weird.
dialog.translation:
Tampoco la Cruz del Sur...
Que raro.

dialog.english:
So we're not in the Northern or
Southern Hemisphere. Hmm.
dialog.translation:
No estamos ni en el hemisferio
norte, ni sur. Hmm.

dialog.english:
Try not to think about it too
much.

You seem to know a lot about
cooking fish, Matt.
dialog.translation:
Parece que sabes mucho de cocina,
Matt.

dialog.english: Did you learn how at home?
Ah, well...
I cook in place of my mom.
Is that so...

I wonder if I should try cooking,
too.
dialog.translation:
Me pregunto si debería probar
también.

dialog.english: Was it hard, fishing with T.K?

Not at all! He's very skillful! It
was enjoyable for me as well.
dialog.translation:
Para nada! Es muy habilidoso!
Me lo pasé bien yo también.

dialog.english: Invite me next time.
He wasn't too much trouble?

All right, next time the three of
us will go fishing together!
dialog.translation:
Vale, la siguiente vez iremos los
tres a pescar juntos!

dialog.english:
I never thought of him as being a
burden to me...
dialog.translation:
Nunca le he visto
como una carga...

dialog.english:
There seem to be normal fish here
and not just Digimon.
dialog.translation:
Parece haber pescado normal aquí.
No sólo Digimon.

dialog.english:
Catching fish was fun, but I don't
like fish bones.
dialog.translation:
Pescar es divertido, pero odio
las espinas.

dialog.english:
I would've taken them out if you'd
asked.
dialog.translation:
Te las hubiese quitado si
preguntases.

dialog.english:
But Tai said it's tastier if
you eat the head whole.
dialog.translation:
Pero Tai dijo que sabe mejor
si te lo comes entero.

dialog.english: Is it really?

Looks like we're safe for tonight,
but... What'll we do tomorrow?
dialog.translation:
Parece que estamos seguros para
esta noche... Pero y mañana?

dialog.english:
We should rest for now and think
about it tomorrow.
dialog.translation:
Descansemos por ahora,
pensemos en eso mañana.

dialog.english: I'm tired, too.
*yawn*
Are you tired, Patamon?
Yeah.

*yawn* I'm full. I should sleep
soon.
Should we keep watch in shifts?
Okay. Let's pick an order.

I don't think the girls should
have to do it. Or T.K.
dialog.translation:
No creo que sea cosa de chicas,
ni para T.K.

dialog.english: I'll be fine!

Don't worry about it. Get some
rest.

Hey, Gabumon. Let me use your pelt
as a blanket!
dialog.translation:
Ey Gabumon. Déjame usar tu capa
de sábana!

dialog.english:
I've always wondered what's under
your fur, Gabumon!
dialog.translation:
Siempre me pregunto que hay bajo
esa piel, Gabumon!

dialog.english: A-a-about that...

Stop it! Can't you see he doesn't
like it?
dialog.translation:
Para! No ves que no le está
gustando?

dialog.english: It was just a joke, don't get mad!
S-stop it! Both of you!

So, who'll take the first shift on
guard duty?
dialog.translation:
Pues... quien hace la primera
guardia?

dialog.english: I'll go first.
I'll go next.
Matt...

Matt's harmonica has such a nice
tone.
dialog.translation:
Su harmónica tiene un
sonido muy bonito.

dialog.english:
(Why did I have to get so angry
over such a little thing?)
dialog.translation:
(Por qué me he enfadado por
una cosa así?)

dialog.english: (I should go check on Tai...)
Apologize to Tai
Don't apologize to Tai

I couldn't sleep. Sorry about
earlier.
dialog.translation:
No podía dormir. Lamento lo
de antes.

dialog.english:
It was my fault too. I keep
getting irritated over stupid
things.
dialog.translation:
Fue mi culpa también. Me irrito
por estupideces.

dialog.english:
I know the feeling. When we can't
hold ourselves together, we just
end up fighting.
dialog.translation:
Lo comprendo. Cuando no nos
controlamos, acabamos discutiendo.

dialog.english:
I just came here to make sure that
you're not falling asleep.
dialog.translation:
He venido para asegurarme de que
no te quedases dormido.

dialog.english:
Right. I'm awake and watching,
don't worry.
dialog.translation:
Ya. Estoy despierto y vigilando.
Descuida.

dialog.english:
By the way, I've been wondering.
What's your relationship to
T.K?
dialog.translation:
Por cierto, me preguntaba...
Qué relación tienes con T.K?

dialog.english:
We're brothers. We've been living
separately ever since our parents
divorced.
dialog.translation:
Somos hermanos. Vivimos separados
desde el divorcio de nuestros
padres.

dialog.english:
I live with our father, and T.K
lives with our mother.
dialog.translation:
Vivo con nuestro padre, y T.K, con
nuestra madre.

dialog.english:
So that's why you have different
surnames.
Yeah.

I've been waiting to use the
bathroom... I wonder where Matt
went.
dialog.translation:
Estaba esperando para ir al baño.
Me pregunto donde está Matt.

dialog.english: Hm? What's this?
An earthquake?
Look over there, it's a monster!
What is that thing?!
That's Seadramon!
T.K!
Uwaaah!
Uwaaaaah!

Matt! Gabumon, do something to
help my brother!
dialog.translation:
Matt! Gabumon, haz algo para
ayudar a mi hermano!

dialog.english:
B-but I can't. I'm not strong
enough.
dialog.translation:
P-pero.. no puedo. No soy tan
fuerte.

dialog.english: This way! Come get me!

Y-Matt! I can't do it. I'm too
scared...
Gabumon...
I'm scared, but!

If I don't do something, I won't
be able to listen to the gentle
tone of Matt's harmonica again.
dialog.translation:
Si no hago nada, no podrá volver a
escuchar el dulce sonido de su
harmónica nunca jamás...

dialog.english: Garurumon? Gabumon evolved!
Amazing, Gabumon! You can do it!

A second evolution! Agumon's not
the only Digimon who can evolve!
dialog.translation:
Otra digievolución! Agumón no es
el único que puede hacerlo!

dialog.english: It looks like we made it. Somehow.

Why didn't you tell me from the
start that you could evolve,
Gabumon?
dialog.translation:
Por que no me dijiste que podías
digievolucionar, Gabumon?

dialog.english:
I couldn't tell you! It was the
first time!
dialog.translation: No lo sabía! Es la primera vez!

dialog.english:
Gabumon! Thanks for saving us! And
thank you too, Matt!
dialog.translation:
Gabumon! Gracias por salvarnos!
Y gracias también, Matt!

dialog.english: I-it wasn't...
You're so shy.
Look who's talking!
Hahaha!

Hey, shouldn't we go back and
check the trolley?
dialog.translation:
Eh, no deberíamos echar un ojo
al tranvía?

dialog.english: I was already planning on it.
(sniff) This is...
What's the matter, Gabumon?

Something smells delicious! Here
in the forest!
dialog.translation:
Algo huele genial! Aquí, en el
bosque!

dialog.english: You're right! Is it fruit?

Fruit? Now that you mention it,
I'm hungry...
dialog.translation:
Fruta? ahora que lo dices,
tengo hambre...

dialog.english:
It could get cold tonight, and we
don't have any way to keep
ourselves warm...
dialog.translation:
Podría refrescar esta noche, y no
tenemos cómo estar al caliente...

dialog.english:
Why don't we set up camp?
Let's go look for food and
materials!
dialog.translation:
Por qué no acampamos?
Vayamos a buscar comida y
materiales.

dialog.english: Ah, these are...!
They look like apples.

They're DigiApples! They're really
sour and tasty!
That doesn't sound very tasty.
Obtained DigiApples!
What's this?

That's firewood! We can cook food
with it.
dialog.translation:
Es leña! Podemos cocinar
con ella.

dialog.english: Can I light it with my Llama Bebé?
dialog.translation: La enciendo con mi Llama Bebé?

dialog.english: I can use my MiniFuego, too.
If I used Disparo de Aire...
You'd blow away the firewood.
Obtained firewood!
These seem to be...

Those are DigiBananas! They're
really juicy!

That's not like the bananas in our
world at all.
dialog.translation:
No se parecen en nada a las de
nuestro mundo.

dialog.english:
It's possible that they're
poisonous to humans.
dialog.translation:
Quizás sean tóxicas para
los humanos.

dialog.english:
It'll be fiiiiiine! Bananas are
bananas!

Ok then. Tai will be the poison
tester.
dialog.translation:
Muy bien. Tai las probará
primero.

dialog.english: Obtained DigiBananas!
These look like...

They're DigiMushrooms! They're
delicious when you bake them!
dialog.translation:
Son DigiSetas! Son deliciosas
si se cocinan bien!

dialog.english:
But you need to be careful.
There's also DigiMushams, and
those are poisonous.
dialog.translation:
Pero ten cuidado. También hay
DigiHongos, que son venenosos.

dialog.english:
So there are poisonous mushrooms
here too.
dialog.translation:
Así que aquí también hay
venenosas.

dialog.english:
Poisonous mushrooms? I'm sure I'll
know one when I see it.
dialog.translation:
Setas venenosas? Seguro que
las reconozco al verlas.

dialog.english:
Really? Then if we need advice,
we'll ask...
dialog.translation:
De veras? Si necesito consejo,
te aviso...

dialog.english:
I won't eat any poisonous ones,
I'm positive! Hahaha!
dialog.translation:
No comeré las venenosas,
seguro! Jajaja!

dialog.english:
Why do I have a bad feeling about
this?
dialog.translation:
Por qué tengo un mal 
presentimiento?

dialog.english: Obtained DigiMushrooms!
So this is...

Seems like it's dry grass. It
burns easily.

But how would you start a fire
with it?
We'll help! Right, Sora?

Thank you, but don't push yourself
too hard.
dialog.translation:
Gracias, pero no te fuerces
demasiado.

dialog.english: (I should check on everyone.)
(I should check on Tai.)

We've got food now, so let's hurry
up and eat!
dialog.translation:
Tenemos comida, démonos prisa y
a comer!

dialog.english:
Yeah...we walked all that way for
it...
dialog.translation:
Si... andamos todo ese rato
para esto.

dialog.english: What do you think, Matt?
Well...
We should make sure it's safe.
Okay, let's eat.
Food! Food!
Oh, Mimi.

There are still things we're not
sure about here.
dialog.translation:
Aún hay cosas de las que no
estamos seguros aquí.

dialog.english: Yeah! I agree with Matt!

Tai, hurry up and cook the
fish!
dialog.translation:
Tai, date prisa y haz
el pescado!

dialog.english:
Don't be in a rush, now, or you'll
burn it. Put the fish near the
fire and...
dialog.translation:
No te apresures, o lo quemarás.
Pon el pescado junto al fuego y...

dialog.english:
H-hey, Matt! Why are you pulling
the fish away?
dialog.translation:
Eh, Matt! Por qué apartas el
pescado?

dialog.english:
You have to cook fish at a
distance.
dialog.translation:
Tiene que cocinarlo algo más
lejos.

dialog.english: Really?
Ah...

What's up, Matt? It's not time
to switch yet.
dialog.translation:
Que pasa, Matt? No toca cambiar
aún.

dialog.english: Tai...
GSHAAAAAAAAAAH!
Aaaaaahh!
I'm worried about everyone else.
It's time to turn in for the night.

This won't be enough for camp.
Let's keep exploring the forest.
dialog.translation:
No será suficiente para acampar.
Sigamos explorando el bosque.
